en: A black-and-white historical photograph postcard depicting a large crowd of people, including women, children, and men in uniform, marching or gathered in a public street. Some are holding banners and flags. The setting appears to be urban with tram tracks visible on the ground and trees in the background. The crowd seems to be participating in a demonstration or parade. There is printed text at the bottom describing the event.
